d: Bayern Munich went to great lengths to secure Jamal Musiala's future, handing the German international a long-term contract and making him one of the faces of the club. But after serious injuries and a neurological condition disrupted his progress, the conversation around him changed. Suddenly, it was about his performances, his contract and his value to Bayern. Rupha Ramani dives deep into the treatment of Jamal Musiala and the question of what loyalty really means when a footballer is at his most vulnerable.
